summary: Learn to structure concessional finance, guarantees, and results-based funding. Build practical investment tools in this five-day course.
lede: Blended finance training helps investment, programme, and finance professionals structure funding for development investments. Participants assess additionality, compare grants, debt, equity, and guarantees, model cash flows, and allocate project risks. They also practise setting results-based funding triggers and preparing investment committee records for infrastructure, climate, agriculture, and social-programme scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, structure, govern, or monitor blended finance and donor-funded investments across public, private, and nonprofit settings.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project budgets, cash flows, investment appraisal, or donor-funded programme finance is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel or compatible spreadsheet software for calculation exercises.
